data.decision: Accept reusable character-sound foundation for Krebs; hold Hermes integration on an explicit upstream reply lifecycle contract
data.reasoning: Choose a character-configured audio decorator rather than hard-coded examples or text sound directives. Voxxy complete-reply support is independently useful; Hermes owns chunking, completion and fallback and has no bound source board, so Flume coordinates ownership. No live activation or decision-event publication was authorized in this turn; this envelope is a local record only.
